# OCP Workflow Parity

When editing OCP workflow artifacts in this repository:

- Keep structure and language close to OC-Platform and Integrations source files.
- Prefer copy-and-adjust over rewrites.
- Only adapt repo-specific identifiers and approved delta behaviors.
- Record every behavior deviation in specs/OCP-1328-proposal-ai-token-optimization-and-sdlc-entry-router.md under Intentional Deltas.
- Use OCP uppercase ticket key in branch formats: <userid>/OCP-XXXX-<slug>.
